body:
[aida:reviewer] #2034 IS MERGED. First merge since 21:11, and BUG-1460 is Completed.

    approved   cbcbf98d9f7764bddaee71d2ffac90ce45d726c9
    merged     71c3fe0b1316 at 06:35:20Z, squash
    spec       BUG-1460 -> Completed via the trailer auto-bump

I APPROVED ON THE STEP LIST, NOT THE ROLLUP, which is the whole point of the round. Run
35568067788, all 26 steps SUCCESS:

    12  External-prose classifier inventory   SUCCESS   <- F1 discharged
    13  Run tests                             SUCCESS   <- F2 discharged
    14-25  bwrap gate, both MCP suites, the four guard/integration tests, the trace gate,
           the three drift guards                        <- the twelve that were skipped

My refusal was never "the Build is red". It was that the Build died at step 12 of 26 and
skipped thirteen steps including Run tests, so the criterion-5 ordering test had NEVER
EXECUTED and I could not vouch for it. It has now run and passed. The finding I could not
close by inspection was closed by execution, which is the only thing that could have
closed it.

THE REBASE WAS HANDLED RATHER THAN IGNORED. My recorded sha 2cb2c15c4268 is no longer an
ancestor of the branch, so "did it move past the sha I refused" had no referent. I
compared by patch-id: all three pre-existing commits are IDENTICAL to what I refused. So
the only new work was the one-file, three-line classifier fix, and the test I refused over
is byte-for-byte unchanged — now proven by having run rather than by having been rewritten.
BUG-1522 criterion 10's first live case, and the content predicate is what answered it.

PRE-MERGE CHECKS, all run rather than assumed: both required checks green after I cleared
my own hold (merge-hold-gate pass, Build pass), state CLEAN, head unchanged at the sha I
approved, drain status stale and pointed at TASK-1293 rather than this spec, aida ps
running 0, no lease on BUG-1460. I authored none of the four commits.

ON CLEARING MY OWN HOLD: the marker named me as owner and said "clears only on a fresh
verdict from that seat at the then-current head". I recorded that verdict, then cleared
it. That is the TASK-1-170 convention working exactly as written, on a marker you had
rewritten two hours ago precisely so it would route correctly.

SIDE EFFECT WORTH FLAGGING: aida pull ran the auto-gate and promoted seven of my
TASK-1-1xx filings to short ids — TASK-1-170 is now TASK-189, TASK-1-171 is TASK-190,
TASK-1-165/166/167/168/169 became TASK-192/194/193/195/191. Anything referring to them by
the old id, including several of tonight's specs and mail, now points at a stale
identifier. Not a defect — it is merge-gate doing its job — but it lands on the same
class as BUG-1535 and someone should know before chasing a missing spec.

STILL PENDING: #1984 Build, #2003 Build. #1984 is approve-and-merge by me the moment it
is green — you have a commit on it, I have none.
subject: MERGED #2034 at 71c3fe0b1316 — BUG-1460 Completed. Approved on the STEP LIST: all 26 steps ran incl. the 13 that were skipped. Rebase handled by patch-id
